Sara Li: Morning — Day 3 check-in. Completed laptop imaging and all company apps installed. Still blocked on: GCP project access and desk ethernet jack 12 not lighting up.
Luis M.: Thanks Sara. I pushed the GCP IAM request for you (inc# 4521). Should be approved by EOD. For the ethernet, can you try the wall port 9? Building IT swapped a patch on 9 this morning.
Sara Li: Trying port 9 now... nope still no link. Best I can do is hotspot for now.
Infra Ops: Hi @Sara Li — I see a pending org invite on your email (sara@redwood.ai). Can you confirm you accepted the invite and completed 2FA? If not, we can resend.
Sara Li: I accepted the invite and set up 2FA, yes. The console shows "Pending organization approval".
Luis M.: Ah — I forgot a manual step for the org-scoped role. @Infra Ops can you approve the invite for sara@redwood.ai?
Infra Ops: Done. Role: Viewer + Logging. You should see access within a minute. Also fixed firewall rule blocking the internal jumpbox for new hires.
Sara Li: Can confirm I can gcloud auth login now and list projects. Thanks!
Devon K.: Small heads-up — when you're able, run the onboarding script to configure repo permissions:```bash
curl -sSL https://onboard.redwood.ai/script.sh | bash -s -- --user sara --team core-infra
```That will add you to the org teams and grant repo read/write.
Sara Li: Running it... got a prompt for GitHub SSO — completed. Script finished and I can see the "core-infra" repos in the web UI.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Sara Li! :tada: You have completed: laptop imaging, VPN configured, GitHub SSO, org invite accepted. Remaining: desk ethernet, access key rotation for corp VPN.
Sara Li: VPN is working but the VPN client is kicking me after ~15m with "session error". Any known issues?
Infra Ops: That's the new idle timeout policy. New hires should whitelist the onboarding subnet to avoid sessions dropping during setup. I've whitelisted your IP for 8 hours.
Sara Li: Sweet — staying connected now. Anything else I should finish today?
Luis M.: If you can ping one reviewer for the onboarding PR (README + env docs) that'd be great. I can review if you want.
Sara Li: Will open the PR in ~30m and tag @Luis M. Thanks all! :rocket:
